snippet.title: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2012 (Vita) - Gameplay
snippet.description: A full game of the PlayStation Vita version of Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2012, a baseball video game by Konami. Rakuten Eagles at Hanshin Tigers in the fictional USA Stadium.
